components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty

      properties:

          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80

          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

      properties:

          description: The first name of the pet owner.

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:

          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'

## Summary

I implemented the telephone-normalization rule for owner creation, following the codebase's existing Bean Validation conventions.

**The problem:** The generated `OwnerFieldsDto.telephone` carried a `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` constraint that rejected any non-digit input at the request boundary (→400) before normalization could ever run — and it enforced no length, so a short all-digit value like `"12345"` slipped through to the entity layer and failed there as a 500.

**Changes:**

1. **`TelephoneNormalizer`** (`rest/validation/`) — a tiny single-responsibility utility whose only job is stripping non-digit characters (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`, null-safe).

2. **`@Telephone` constraint + `TelephoneValidator`** — mirrors the existing `@PetAgeValidation`/`PetAgeValidator` pair. It validates that the normalized value is *exactly 10 digits*, producing a clean `400` through the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — removed the digits-only `pattern` (so formatted input reaches the validator) and attached `@Telephone` alongside the existing `@NotBlank` via `x-field-extra-annotation`, the same wiring mechanism already used for `@PetAgeValidation`.

4. **`OwnerMapper`** — added a `@Named("normalizeTelephone")` mapping on the create path (`toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`) that stores the bare 10-digit value using the shared normalizer.

The normalizer is reused by both the validator (strip → check length) and the mapper (strip → store), so the stripping logic lives in exactly one place. The entity's existing `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` is satisfied by the normalized value, so no entity change was needed. `"(04) 1234-5678"` → stored/returned as `"0412345678"`; `"12345"` → `400`.
